profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building cloud-native backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, AWS, Terraform, REST APIs, Kafka, and CI/CD pipelines. Experienced designing scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud automation, and infrastructure as code in Agile environments. Passionate about improving software quality, developer productivity, and system reliability through automation and modern engineering practices.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed automated unit tests and participated in functional and system integration testing to improve software reliability and deployment confidence.
Designed, developed, and maintained cloud-native microservices using Java, Spring Boot, AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS, and Amazon S3, improving scalability, reliability, and maintainability of distributed systems.
Automated cloud infrastructure provisioning using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC), enabling repeatable deployments, environment consistency, and scalable cloud architecture.
Developed event-driven applications using Apache Kafka, implementing producer and consumer services with Java Spring Boot and REST APIs to enable scalable asynchronous communication between distributed microservices.
Designed serverless automation solutions using Python 3.11, AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and cloud storage services to automate scheduled database archival processes.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Assisted in deploying test and development environments using Jenkins CI/CD pipeline as part of the Crew Watch and Recovery team.
Actively participated in Agile methodologies and collaborated closely with team members to meet project milestones.
Engaged in Java backend development tasks, supporting the team in coding, debugging, and testing features aligned with project requirements on the Crew Compensation team.
As part of the ADEPT program participated in hackathons and training to develop skills building applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Worked alongside a small team of developers to deliver three new features and enhancements to an existing a web application that directly impacted internal users.
Directly involved in the technical interview process for new candidates to the project.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Utilized AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda Functions, CloudWatch Logs, etc.) alongside Python to develop a solution for processing data to improve the preexisting content management system transitioning from on-prem to cloud.
Worked in an agile development environment attending daily standups giving updates on my work.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Utilized Java programming language in various modules and coding exercises designed to recreate programming in the world of business.
Collaborated with a small team to design, test, and develop an innovative solution for a small business.
Utilized Unity, C#, React, Javascript to create a mobile VR app on Android and IOS platforms that simulated an environment to allow small business owners to interact with customers virtually as a solution to the impact of COVID. Experience using Node.js to host the application on a server.
